Preserve the native rusty red streaks and ragged damage on armor and cloth. The right hand holds the original short straight silver sword with small crossguard and rusty red blade marking; left hand is empty. Preserve the thin arrows lodged through the torso and projecting behind the shoulders, their pale feather fletching and exact native placement in each view. Long slender legs, narrow body, worn tarnished surfaces and heavy dark native tonal weight. No living skin, eyes, extra weapons, shield, cape, jewelry, glow or invented ornaments. Keep native armor, bone, cloth and metal material boundaries clear for offline native palette variants; preserve the exact native damage without adding any.
